parts.problem_md: What is the effect when a trader does not account for rent paid in advance?
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> **The correct answer is D** (Other receivables understated)
> 
> - A is not correct because rent paid in advance would not affect gross profit
> - B is not correct because rent paid in advance would not affect gross profit
> - C is not correct because rent paid in advance would not overstate other receivables
